editorial.name: Art Deco Robot
editorial.description: An angular silver machine face, charcoal waistcoat, silver trousers and metallic gloves create a silent mechanical performer.
editorial.alt: Silver geometric robot mask, charcoal waistcoat over a black shirt, silver trousers, silver gloves and black shoes.
editorial.tip: Wear your own black shirt and comfortable black shoes. Practice a few slow, precise turns to bring the machine to life.

editorial.name: Haunted Prom Queen
editorial.description: A burgundy velvet gown, rose crown and white Prom Queen sash turn formalwear into a ghost story.
editorial.alt: Burgundy velvet floor-length gown, brass rose crown, white Prom Queen sash and dark ankle boots.
editorial.tip: Use a gown you already own if you can. Add smudged eye makeup and a faded corsage for the haunted effect.

editorial.name: Headless Horseman
editorial.description: Raised shoulders and a black cloak hide the head inside a theatrical illusion, with dark trousers and riding-style boots.
editorial.alt: Headless illusion costume with a black cape, raised empty collar, white lace ascot, black trousers and tall dark boots.
pieces: Headless illusion coat, cape and supports
editorial.tip: Fit the shoulder supports before dressing. Check the mesh sightline in good light, and keep the cape clear of your feet.

editorial.name: Phantom of the Opera
editorial.description: A white half mask and sweeping black cape frame a ruffled shirt and dark waistcoat for a dramatic entrance.
editorial.alt: White half-face phantom mask, black cape with burgundy lining, white ruffled shirt, black waistcoat, own black trousers and tall black boots.
pieces: Black waistcoat — wear with your own black trousers
editorial.tip: Keep the mask on one side of the face. Wear your own black trousers, and let the pale shirt show at the collar.

editorial.name: Silent Film Star
editorial.description: A black top hat, ivory shirt and charcoal waistcoat pair with pale stage makeup for a walking silent movie.
editorial.alt: Black top hat, ivory collared shirt, charcoal waistcoat, high-waisted black trousers and pale stage makeup, with own black shoes.
editorial.tip: Bring your own black shoes and a handwritten dialogue card. White gloves and a bow tie are optional finishes; the makeup row supplies white cream only.
